information: ## This competition is on a weekday! This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UCSDWeeknightsVIII2025#64161-competitor-responsibilities-faq) tab. **Spectators can attend for free** and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating. ###This is a favorites competition! To learn more about favorites competitions, visit the [What is a Favorites Competition?](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UCSDWeeknightsVIII2025#64165-what-is-a-favorites-competition) tab. This competition is organized by the Rubik's Cube Club @ UC San Diego, in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTI4OTE0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--c06cddf0948fb0f610e19894d680fde20dbe44aa/UCSDCubeClub_Stretched.png)
